releases.notes:
Audrey's Additions version 1.0.4 is out! Here's our changelog:
```Desktops -
* (Custom) Primm
  (Designed by FuzzyLeo!)
* (1963) Brachacki (Major update)
* (1975) Ruscoe I
* (1977) Newbery II (to-do)
* (1981) Ruscoe II (to-do)

Console Units -
Sharp (Altered)
* Variants: Season 13, Season 16, Season 20, Memory

Silence Time-Ship
* New variant: Rainbow Obsidian

Toyota
* New variant: Missy, updated Default and Blue

Shells -
Lakertyan Pyramid
* New variant: Warforge

TARDIS Cabinet
* Variants: Each wood type

Police Box (1963)
* New variants: Pilot, Adventure

Police Box (1966)
* New variant: Season 13

Police Box (1976)
* New variants: Season 16, Season 17, Black Orchid

Police Box (1980)
* New variant: Dimensional

Police Box (2005)
* Variants: Time War

Police Box (2010)
* New variant: Adverts

Blocks -
- Ceiling Canopy (Added Zeiton variant)
- Liminton Monitor (Slight update)
- Zeiton Quartz Block (+ Stairs and Slab)
- Smooth Zeiton Quartz (+ Stairs and Slab)
- Zeiton Quartz Pillar
- Zeiton Quartz Bricks
- Chiseled Zeiton Quartz
- Treated Light Column (Left and Right)
- Treated Chiseled Zeiton Quartz
- Treated Zeiton Quartz Bricks

- Roundels
* What are the round things? A dyeable, decorative block to give your spaces that Gallifreyan flair! Placed in the TARDIS, they will dim as your power lowers, so keep her fueled to ensure she looks her best!

- Hatstand
* Drape your clothes and armor on this decorational block, with unique designs for each wood variant!

- TARDIS Cabinet
* Straight from the Toymaker's domain, a storage block capable of holding and displaying up to 8 item stacks, decorate your spaces with an array of wooden TARDIS-styled Cabinets!

Bug Fixes/Changes -
- All Addon Console Units now have interactive controls! The Throttle and Handbrake will shift with your adjustments, and the current fuel level and progress towards your destination will sometimes be reflected on the Console Unit.
- Redid Specimen Jar inventory sprites to reflect held Mob
- Increased framerate for all Addon console units (and cats!)
- Renamed canon Desktops to include introduction year
- Fixed minor texture issue on default Lakertyan Pyramid interior door
- Fixed some Console Configurator holograms using wrong texture
- Fixed Armchair and Knossos Throne occasionally desyncing their state
- Fixed Light Column (Left) being uncraftable, tweaked both Column recipes
- Updated Newbery Console Unit control hitboxes
- Renamed Grandfather Clock variants for readability
- Fixed incorrect hitbox for Liminton Monitor
- Fixed minor block palette issue in Tremas desktop
- Fixed model error on Sharp Console Unit
- Slight tweak to Police Box (1976) and Police Box (1980)
- Slight tweak to Master variant of Sharp Console
- Attempted fix for Fold-out Bed desyncing on servers
- Fixed pick-blocking Armchairs not retaining color data
- Fixed several blocks not dropping as expected in Survival
```
Download it at:
https://modrinth.com/project/tardis-refined-audreys-additions
https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tardis-refined-audreys-additions

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Jeryn99/AudreysAdditions/compare/v1.20.1-1.0.3...v1.20.1-1.0.4

releases.notes:
Audrey's Additions version 1.0.3 is out! Here's our changelog:
Please note that the Ceiling Canopy has changed, you'll need to reuse the Pattern Manipulator on it!
```Desktops -
* Brachacki (Fix)
* Thornton (1983)
* Tremas (1984)
* Rani (1985)
* Fugitive (2020)

Console Units -
Kelt Console Unit
* New variant: Warrior (2022)

Rani Console Unit (1985)
* Variants: Crimson, End, Keltic, Nether, White

Silence Time Ship (2010)

Shells -
Police Box (1980)
* Variants: Season 20, Season 22, Season 24, Happiness Patrol

Grandfather Clock
* Variants: Each wood type

Sandstone Column
* Variant: Red Sandstone

TT Capsule
* Variant: Type 40

Iron Maiden

Rani's Wardrobe
* Variants: Iron, Nether Brick, Purpur, Quartz, Sandstone, Stone, Wooden

Telephone Booth
* Variant: Bee

Lakertyan Pyramid

Blocks:
- Ceiling Canopy
* New variants: Stone, Tremas

- Specimen Jar
* With Allay, Creeper, Dragon, Skeleton, Piglin, Vex, Wither Skeleton, and Zombie variants
* A decorative block for scientific research, when crafted with a mob skull you can display an infantile version of the mob, pickled in time like a gherkin in a jar.. A certain rogue Time Lady's desktop may provide a container to start.
* If you're feeling more cruel, you can also capture Vexes or Allays in the wild for study.

Bug Fixes:
- Added recipe for Food Machine
- Tweaked model of Police Box interior doors (2010 + 2018), exterior keyhole is no longer 3D
- Fixed clipping error on Police Box (1966) and its variants
- Fixed rendering error on Police Box (1966) interior doors
- Fixed palette fidelity error on Knossos Throne Acacia variant

Known Bugs:
- Rendering error on Lakertyan Pyramid when in snow, will be fixed in the next TARDIS Refined release
```
Download it at:
https://modrinth.com/project/tardis-refined-audreys-additions
https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tardis-refined-audreys-additions

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Jeryn99/AudreysAdditions/compare/v1.20.1-1.0.2...v1.20.1-1.0.3
